facts.fact: The Windhoek Observer, citing the Ministry of Finance's 2026/27 budget estimates, reports that drafting of Namibia's Cybercrime Bill is complete and it is expected to go to Parliament in March 2026 after a validation workshop.

The Windhoek Observer, citing the Ministry of Finance's 2026/27 budget estimates, reports the Data Protection Bill has been approved by the cabinet committee on legislation and forwarded to the Ministry of Justice and Labour Relations for further review.
